info.title: Marquinhos Activity room protocol
info.description: Application messages inside Colyseus WebSocket frames. Use the Colyseus SDK to reserve a seat and open the socket. These payloads describe decoded application values.

local.description: Direct API listener. The Discord Activity connects through its configured Colyseus proxy prefix.

room.title: Shared match controls
room.description: Room controls share the same connection as the active game. The SDK reserves a seat in the match room. Room admission verifies the signed token and room key.

processId.description: Colyseus process ID from the seat reservation.

roomId.description: Colyseus transport room ID from the seat reservation.

receive_switch_game.name: switch_game
receive_switch_game.description: The current host requests another game in the same multiplayer room between matches.

receive_toggle_queue.name: toggle_queue
receive_toggle_queue.description: The current host enables or disables the waiting queue.

receive_rotate_seat.name: rotate_seat
receive_rotate_seat.description: A seated player gives their seat to the first queued player between matches.

send_room_state.name: room_state
send_room_state.description: Current game, host, match status, and public seat and queue assignments.

send_action_rejected.name: action_rejected
send_action_rejected.description: A client action failed a room, permission, or gameplay check.

battleship.title: battleship
battleship.description: Players place fleets and fire at coordinates. The server sends each viewer a board with hidden ships masked.

processId.description: Colyseus process ID from the seat reservation.

roomId.description: Colyseus transport room ID from the seat reservation.

bingo-speed.title: bingo-speed
bingo-speed.description: The server broadcasts called numbers. Clients can claim Bingo and receive the result of the server’s claim check.

processId.description: Colyseus process ID from the seat reservation.

roomId.description: Colyseus transport room ID from the seat reservation.

boggle-word-race.title: boggle-word-race
boggle-word-race.description: Players submit words from a shared letter board. The server tracks found words and round scores.

processId.description: Colyseus process ID from the seat reservation.

roomId.description: Colyseus transport room ID from the seat reservation.

cards.title: cards
cards.description: The active ruleset defines legal moves. State views are masked per recipient so only allowed card information is sent.

processId.description: Colyseus process ID from the seat reservation.

roomId.description: Colyseus transport room ID from the seat reservation.

receive_move.name: move
receive_move.description: Submit a move defined by the active ruleset. The room also checks seat and turn state.

send_state.name: state
send_state.description: Per-client Truco state including the moves available to the current viewer.

checkers.title: checkers
checkers.description: Players send one move at a time. The server reports board positions and whether the active piece must continue capturing.

processId.description: Colyseus process ID from the seat reservation.

roomId.description: Colyseus transport room ID from the seat reservation.

connect-four.title: connect-four
connect-four.description: Players select a column. The server updates the board and turn after checking the move.

processId.description: Colyseus process ID from the seat reservation.

roomId.description: Colyseus transport room ID from the seat reservation.

dominoes-block.title: dominoes-block
dominoes-block.description: Players place a tile at an end of the chain or pass. The server sends per-player views and resolves the round.

processId.description: Colyseus process ID from the seat reservation.

roomId.description: Colyseus transport room ID from the seat reservation.

hangman.title: hangman
hangman.description: Players guess letters. The server tracks the revealed word, used letters, and match outcome.

processId.description: Colyseus process ID from the seat reservation.

roomId.description: Colyseus transport room ID from the seat reservation.

minesweeper-versus.title: minesweeper-versus
minesweeper-versus.description: Players request cell reveals. The server sends board snapshots, reveal results, or rejection details.

processId.description: Colyseus process ID from the seat reservation.

roomId.description: Colyseus transport room ID from the seat reservation.

pong.title: pong
pong.description: Clients send sequenced input and lobby controls. The server sends binary game snapshots and structured lobby and connection messages.

processId.description: Colyseus process ID from the seat reservation.

roomId.description: Colyseus transport room ID from the seat reservation.

send_state.name: state
send_state.title: Pong binary snapshot
send_state.description: Decode the Colyseus byte payload with decodeStateSnapshot from @marquinhos/contracts/activity/pong/codec. The versioned little-endian layout starts with a fixed header and includes counted collections.

rock-paper-scissors.title: rock-paper-scissors
rock-paper-scissors.description: The server collects player choices and publishes a round result after both choices are in.

processId.description: Colyseus process ID from the seat reservation.

roomId.description: Colyseus transport room ID from the seat reservation.

snake-game.title: snake-game
snake-game.description: Clients send direction changes. The server owns movement, collisions, and the match clock.

processId.description: Colyseus process ID from the seat reservation.

roomId.description: Colyseus transport room ID from the seat reservation.

tic-tac-toe.title: tic-tac-toe
tic-tac-toe.description: Players select a cell. The server validates turns and publishes the authoritative board.

processId.description: Colyseus process ID from the seat reservation.

roomId.description: Colyseus transport room ID from the seat reservation.

tower-unstable.title: tower-unstable
tower-unstable.description: Players pull blocks from the shared tower. Server updates record the last pull, player order, and any eliminations.

processId.description: Colyseus process ID from the seat reservation.

roomId.description: Colyseus transport room ID from the seat reservation.

trivia-quiz.title: trivia-quiz
trivia-quiz.description: The server sends questions and reveals results. Clients submit answer selections for the active question.

processId.description: Colyseus process ID from the seat reservation.

roomId.description: Colyseus transport room ID from the seat reservation.

word-chain.title: word-chain
word-chain.description: Players submit words under the active chain rule. The server controls the turn and validates the submission.

processId.description: Colyseus process ID from the seat reservation.

roomId.description: Colyseus transport room ID from the seat reservation.

word-search-race.title: word-search-race
word-search-race.description: Players submit candidate word selections from the puzzle grid. The server tracks found words and scores.

processId.description: Colyseus process ID from the seat reservation.

roomId.description: Colyseus transport room ID from the seat reservation.

wordle.title: wordle
wordle.description: The daily round is persisted by the API. The client requests a fresh snapshot with wordle_sync at join and after reconnect. A dropped seat is reserved for 30 seconds.

processId.description: Colyseus process ID from the seat reservation.

roomId.description: Colyseus transport room ID from the seat reservation.

wordle-race.title: wordle-race
wordle-race.description: Players submit guesses in a shared race. Server messages communicate progress and settle the race.

processId.description: Colyseus process ID from the seat reservation.

roomId.description: Colyseus transport room ID from the seat reservation.

seatReservation.name: sessionId
seatReservation.description: Colyseus seat reservation ID supplied by the SDK on WebSocket connect. Matchmaking requires the signed Activity room token and matching room key. The SDK supplies a reconnection token when resuming an eligible connection.
